                max_concurrent_downloads = $2,

                theme = $3,
                default_page = $4,
                collapsed_navigation = $5,
                advanced_rendering = $6,

                background_effect = $10,

                page_background_path = $12,
                page_background_opacity = $13,
                proxy_enabled = $14,
                proxy_type = $15,
                proxy_host = $16,
                proxy_port = $17,
                proxy_auth_enabled = $18,
                proxy_username = $19,
                proxy_password = $20,
